title: The Quiet Compiler
author: Mara Ellison
recommendation: 把「写编译器」拆成一个周末就能跑通的小步骤。读完以后，我第一次觉得解析器不是黑魔法。

sentences.text: Start with the smallest language that can still surprise you.
sentences.note: 适合当 side project 的原则

sentences.text: A parser is a promise that every string has exactly one meaning, or none.
sentences.note: 写表达式解析题时一直没想清楚的就是这句

sentences.text: Error messages are the part of the compiler your users read most.
